tasks.subject: B10.2: features/acquisition/pipeline.py -- real shared-breaker/checkpoint orchestration; troop349-schedule repointed
tasks.description:
**Goal:** MAJOR REDESIGN post-Codex-review. A new features/acquisition/pipeline.py is the ONE home for CLI batch orchestration: loads inputs, launches one browser, drives every scout through run_batch's shared breaker/checkpoint/RunIdentity, publishes the report, all bracketed by RunStateMachine with correct COMPLETE-after-reporting and CANCEL/CANCELLED-vs-FAIL semantics. process_scout/async_main become thin shims. interfaces/cli/schedule.py (troop349-schedule, sub-plan 3) is repointed to call this pipeline directly instead of scout_schedule_cli.async_main, since B10.4 deletes that file.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/scoutmb/features/acquisition/pipeline.py`
- Modify: `src/scoutmb/features/acquisition/batch.py` (run_batch gains progress_callback/resume_event/run_state params), `scout_schedule_cli.py`, `src/scoutmb/interfaces/cli/schedule.py`, `tests/architecture/test_dependency_rules.py`
- Test: `tests/integration/test_acquisition_pipeline.py`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] A single RetryPolicy is shared across the WHOLE pipeline run (not rebuilt per scout) -- breaker opens on cross-scout consecutive failures, proven with 3+ scouts where the 3rd is never attempted after a threshold-2 trip
- [ ] Checkpoint store actually used: resumed run (same --output) skips completed scouts, reuses output_ids
- [ ] RunEvent.COMPLETE applied only AFTER reporting succeeds -- a reporting failure after clean acquisition applies FAIL, not a false-COMPLETE
- [ ] A real asyncio.CancelledError maps to CANCEL then CANCELLED, never FAIL
- [ ] interfaces/cli/schedule.py's main() calls run_schedule_pipeline directly, does NOT import scout_schedule_cli
- [ ] Every ACQ-*/CLI-SCHED-* execution key still passes both runners
- [ ] scout_schedule_cli.py passes the shape check

**Verify:** `uv run pytest tests/characterization/test_acquisition_matrix.py tests/parity/test_acquisition_parity.py tests/characterization/test_cli_sched_matrix.py tests/integration/test_acquisition_pipeline.py tests/architecture -q` → PASS

CRITICAL POST-CODEX FIX: the original B10.2 rebuilt the breaker per-scout (defeating ACQ-BREAKER's whole point), never touched the checkpoint store despite it being 'reclassified' as composed, conflated cancellation with failure, and recorded COMPLETE before reporting ran. Also fixed a SEPARATE independently-found bug: troop349-schedule imported a module this sub-plan deletes with nothing repointed. NOTE: tests/integration/test_acquisition_pipeline.py ships with 3 explicitly-skipped test stubs pending a read of tests/vertical/test_legacy_flows.py's async_playwright monkeypatch pattern -- these must be completed before this task is done, not left as the actual coverage. See plan doc Task B10.2 in full.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/scoutmb/features/acquisition/pipeline.py", "src/scoutmb/features/acquisition/batch.py", "scout_schedule_cli.py", "src/scoutmb/interfaces/cli/schedule.py", "tests/architecture/test_dependency_rules.py"], "verifyCommand": "uv run pytest tests/characterization/test_acquisition_matrix.py tests/parity/test_acquisition_parity.py tests/characterization/test_cli_sched_matrix.py tests/integration/test_acquisition_pipeline.py tests/architecture -q", "acceptanceCriteria": ["breaker shared across whole run", "checkpoint actually wired", "COMPLETE only after reporting", "cancellation mapped correctly", "troop349-schedule does not import scout_schedule_cli", "no parity regression", "shape check passes"], "modelTier": "standard", "requiresUserSpecification": true}
```
